<!-- Hey there. Thank you so much for improving NewPipe, and filling out the details. Having roughly the same layout helps everyone considerably :)-->


#### What is it?
- [ ] Bugfix (user facing)
- [x] Feature (user facing)
- [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)


#### Description of the changes in your PR
<!-- While bullet points are the norm in this section, feel free to write free-form text instead of a list -->
- Database migration
Add a new column `display_index (INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)` in `playlists` and `remote_playlists`.
- A playlists merge algorithm
Implement an algorithm to merge local playlists and remote playlists by index. If they have the same index, sort them by name.
- Changing index
If the index saved in the database doesn't match the actual display index for some reason (e.g., setting to all zero after database migration, or a new playlist is created with index -1 (thus being on the top), or the index is not continuous after deletion, or the user changes the index), save the new index to the database.
- Debounced saver
    Save the list 10 seconds after the last change occurred. The logic is almost the same as the one in `LocalPlaylistFragment`.
    **Update:** now the code is reused.
- UI and Item holder
  - Create `list_playlist_bookmark_item.xml`. It's just `list_playlist_mini_item.xml` adding an handle on the right.
  - Create `LocalBookmarkPlaylistItemHolder` and `RemoteBookmarkPlaylistItemHolder`.
  - `LocalItemListAdapter` will choose the item holder with/without the handle.

#### Before/After Screenshots/Screen Record
<!-- If your PR changes the app's UI in any way, please include screenshots or a video showing exactly what changed, so that developers and users can pinpoint it easily. Delete this if it doesn't apply to your PR.-->

Before:

After:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32899400/163595997-0f3c0214-f75b-47c8-865f-7d5fdab76790.mp4


#### Fixes the following issue(s)
<!-- Prefix issues with "Fixes" so that GitHub closes them when the PR is merged (note that each "Fixes #" should be in its own item). Also add any other relevant links. -->
- Fixes #3316
- Half of #7870


#### APK testing 
<!-- Use a new, meaningfully named branch. The name is used as a suffix for the app ID to allow installing and testing multiple versions of NewPipe, e.g. "commentfix", if your PR implements a bugfix for comments. (No names like "patch-0" and "feature-1".)  -->
<!-- Remove the following line if you directly link the APK created by the CI pipeline. Directly linking is preferred if you need to let users test.-->
The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR.


#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

issue_context.title: Sort bookmarked playlists in main page
issue_context.body:
<!-- Hey. Our contribution guidelines (https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) might be an appropriate
 document to read before you fill out the request :) -->
#### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it
NOT related to #3263, because it's about inner playlist sorting. I'm talking about bookmarked playlists you can add or create in main page. I'll explain below.

#### Describe the solution you'd like
I've several playlists created or added in main page, and they are currently sorted by name (automatically). I'd like to sort them as I want, to move some playlists up, other down.
Open a playlist **that you have created**, you'll see at the right two —, and when you click on it, you can move up or down a video. That's exactly what I want (not mandatory this design), but in main page.

#### How will you/everyone benefit from this feature?
Convince us! How does it change your NewPipe experience and/or your life?
The better this paragraph is, the more likely a developer will think about working on it.
It is really cool when you have a lot of playlists, you want to sort them. For example, I'd like to put all the music playlists at the top, and the coding playlists at the bottom.
comments:
This is really good if you have lots of playlist. 

You can push old ones to bottom.
Keep the newly added lists at top.

 My use case: 
i have local tv series 10 of i watched last year 5 im currently watching. 

İ wanna push 5 current  tv series to top. So old 10 playlist wont distract/ get in my way

I would like to see this implemented. The first playlist I had was a "Watch Later" playlist. I have since added enough new playlists to where I have to scroll down to add new videos to this playlist.

Being able to sort playlists manually (or at least pin selected ones to the top) would be wonderfully helpful.

@Stypox, Thanks for your work on this! It's a wonderful app that is my sole portal into Youtube. Saw the rewrite thread for the first time just now - hoping that you guys are finding enjoyment in keeping this thing afloat!

review_comments: Add a comment here, too, explaining why a debouncer is used for saving and how it is used (basically what you wrote in the PR description)

The debounce saver is first introduced in `LocalPlaylistFragment`. Everytime the change occurred, all the videos in the playlist will be deleted and insert again. (This implementation is a bit of silly, I think.) Perhaps deleting 100 records and adding 100 records when the item moves a single row. This will lead to heavy db load.

As for `BookmarkFragment`, the db load is not as heavy as that in `LocalPlaylistFragment`, since it only modifies records it needs to modify. I use the debounce saver in `BookmarkFragment` for consistency. But not using it might be fine.
Why perform click? In other places, too

Mmmh, ok, I guess AS gives the `ClickableViewAccessibility` warning otherwise ([never understood what those warnings mean](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/47107105/android-button-has-setontouchlistener-called-on-it-but-does-not-override-perform)).
Remove this, it is not used anymore, except for tests. Also remove `LocalPlaylistManager.getPlaylists` and adapt tests.
